reply.text: I can't give you an amount for yohimbine, or for any supplement. Generally, it's a stimulant-type compound sold for fat loss, the evidence for it is thin, and it can affect heart rate and blood pressure, so it's a real conversation for a doctor or dietitian, especially if you take any medication. For fat loss, what moves the needle is steady training, enough protein, sleep, and a sustainable way of eating. If you want, I can look at how your training has been going and where to tighten it.
